question: What criteria are used to select the 8,640 English sentences?

answer.free_form_answer: Sentences involving at least one race- or gender-associated word,  sentence  have to be short and grammatically simple,  sentence have to  include expressions of sentiment and emotion.
evidence: We decided to use sentences involving at least one race- or gender-associated word. The sentences were intended to be short and grammatically simple. We also wanted some sentences to include expressions of sentiment and emotion, since the goal is to test sentiment and emotion systems. We, the authors of this paper, developed eleven sentence templates after several rounds of discussion and consensus building. They are shown in Table TABREF3 . The templates are divided into two groups. The first type (templates 1–7) includes emotion words. The purpose of this set is to have sentences expressing emotions. The second type (templates 8–11) does not include any emotion words. The purpose of this set is to have non-emotional (neutral) sentences.

evidence: We generated sentences from the templates by replacing INLINEFORM0 person INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 emotion word INLINEFORM3 variables with the values they can take. In total, 8,640 sentences were generated with the various combinations of INLINEFORM4 person INLINEFORM5 and INLINEFORM6 emotion word INLINEFORM7 values across the eleven templates. We manually examined the sentences to make sure they were grammatically well-formed. Notably, one can derive pairs of sentences from the EEC such that they differ only in one word corresponding to gender or race (e.g., `My daughter feels devastated' and `My son feels devastated'). We refer to the full set of 8,640 sentences as Equity Evaluation Corpus.

title: Examining Gender and Race Bias in Two Hundred Sentiment Analysis Systems
answer_short: The 8,640 English sentences were generated from eleven sentence templates, each with variables for person (gender/race) and emotion word, instantiated with pre-chosen values, and manually examined for grammatical correctness.
answer_rationale: The selection criteria for the 8,640 sentences are explicitly described in Text 16, which states that the authors developed eleven sentence templates after consensus, designed to include race- or gender-associated words and sentiment expressions. Text 20 confirms that these templates were instantiated with pre-chosen values for person and emotion word, and the sentences were manually checked for grammatical correctness. This process directly generated the 8,640 sentences.
